display_long_description:
**Never tried cross stitch before? Totally okay!**

**Always swapping between YouTube tutorials and your stitching? We can help!** 💛

Cross Craft is a cozy Mixed Reality cross-stitching app that helps you learn, stitch, and create with confidence in your real space. 🧵

Patterns are used entirely in-headset, where you can customize thread colors in mixed reality to match what you have or try new color combinations. 🧪

Cross Craft helps you stay organized too. Your project can generate a shopping list on your mobile device and track your thread inventory, with DMC colors supported. 👀

Whether you are picking up a needle for the first time or just want some guidance, Cross Craft keeps your hands free and your focus on making something lovely. ✨

Join our Discord to try new features, share feedback, and help shape Cross Craft:
https://discord.com/invite/sU3FTckW4U

**Learn more at crosscraft.coalcar.ca**
